explanations.18: position: relative here means the copy button (which will be positioned absolutely) will be positioned relative to this terminal container instead of floating somewhere else on the page.
explanations.44: flex-shrink: 0 prevents the icon from getting squeezed smaller when there's not enough space — it stays at exactly 16×16 pixels no matter what.
explanations.82: white-space: pre-wrap means the terminal respects your line breaks and spaces (like in actual code), but also wraps long lines instead of making them scroll off screen.
explanations.83: word-break: break-all is an aggressive backup that will break words mid-word if a single word is too long to fit — it ensures nothing escapes the container.
explanations.111: min-width: 0 is a trick that lets flex items shrink below their content size; without it, flex won't actually compress the text inside.
explanations.154: fill: currentcolor means the SVG icon will inherit whatever text color is set, so it automatically becomes the right color without needing a separate color rule.
explanations.174: padding: inherit copies the padding from the parent (the terminal body) so the overlay sits perfectly on top with text aligned exactly in the same spot.
explanations.175: white-space: inherit and word-break: inherit ensure the overlay respects the same text-wrapping behavior as the content below it during animation.
explanations.201: :is() lets you write one rule for all heading levels (h1 through h6) instead of repeating the same styles six times.
